name: Western Digital Corporation
research_rationale: Q1 FY26 revenue and ~$4.3bn TTM FCF support the buy screen, but November’s sector selloff, Jericho’s exit and GAAP Sandisk noise make timing riskier without weakening the HDD cash story.

weekly_updates.summary:
November press coverage highlights a sharp memory/tech drawdown (about 10–20% over the month) and Jericho Capital’s reported full exit in Q3.
Refreshed metrics show Q1 FY26 revenue of $4.38bn and TTM free cash flow about $4.29bn; Rosenblatt’s Buy rating was reiterated in the news batch.
New regulatory colour is limited to a 20 Nov 8-K on shareholder voting; no new earnings filing in the supplied sources.

No material change.
The incremental news batch since the last refresh contains no new articles.
Prior sources (metrics, November press, 20 Nov 8-K) are unchanged in the supplied files.
